title: Sunday · the bay in October
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The last big landscape Sunday of the public run: the bay from the bluff in October, everything in it — the dock, the drift log, the cannery, the school's roof, the Lanes on the hill with its letters mostly dark, the ridge and the glow. The town, whole, once more, before the last Sunday redraws the cafeteria.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the bay from the bluff in October light, and in it everything: Gully's dock and shack, the drift log, the cannery's chimney, the school's flat roof, main street's backs, the Lanes' sign on the hill with most tubes dark, and east above the ridge, the glow, large.
